answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so old interactions steadily lose weight and sustained honest service is needed to build durable trust. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has almost no reputable, reciprocal support and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; transitive trust cannot amplify an unsupported identity enough to pass consensus. Whether named mesa, comet, or terrace, a new identity cannot substitute a track record for trust.
